title: Analysis of NOAC Plasma Levels: Are Palliative Care Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Metastatic Cancer adequately Anticoagulated?
summary: Aim of the study is to analyze the plasma levels of non-vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulants (NOACs) in patients with metastatic cancer and atrial fibrillation, based on blood samples collected during routine clinical care. Currently, there are no established recommendations regarding appropriate dosing for this specific patient population. Specifically, by analyzing plasma levels, the study seeks to determine whether these levels fall within the target range when administered at standard doses, and whether there is a correlation between these levels and clinical events, such as strokes. These findings will allow for conclusions to be drawn regarding the point at which NOAC therapy remains clinically beneficial; the point at which a failure to maintain target plasma levels should be regarded as the discontinuation of life-prolonging therapy; and how plasma levels evolve during the period preceding the end of life.
